ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.IMALL_EksportInfoBlok') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsProcedure') = 1) DROP PROCEDURE CDN.IMALL_EksportInfoBlok

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.IMALL_EksportInfoBlok @ID INT -- ID e-sklepu ,@ExpOpcje INT -- Maska opcji eksportu AS SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @TimeStamp INT
SET @TimeStamp = DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'19900101',121),GETDATE())
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_PicoID = @ID) BEGIN SELECT @ID = PcK_PicoID FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_iMallID = CAST(@ID AS VARCHAR(20)) END
/******** Update timestampów w PicoKonfig *********/ UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchr = @TimeStamp WHERE PcK_PicoId = @ID
IF (@ExpOpcje & 1 = 1) -- eksport cennika UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchrTwr = @TimeStamp WHERE PcK_PicoId = @ID
IF((@ExpOpcje & 4) / 4 = 1) -- eksport grup UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchrGrup = @TimeStamp WHERE PcK_PicoId = @ID
SET NOCOUNT OFF
SELECT PcK_iMallID AS CustomerID ,PcK_TSSynchr AS TSSynchr ,PcK_TSSynchrTwr AS TSSynchrTwr ,PcK_TSSynchrGrup AS TSSynchrGrup ,PcK_TSSynchrKnt AS TSSynchrKntPtw ,CASE WHEN @ExpOpcje = 0 THEN 1 ELSE @ExpOpcje END AS EksportTyp ,2 AS ZrodloID ,CASE WHEN @ExpOpcje = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Koniec
FROM CDN.PicoKonfig AS INFOBLOK WHERE PcK_PicoID = @ID FOR XML AUTO
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.IMALL_EksportInfoBlok TO CDNRaport
